blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived in Manila on Monday to participate in the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) summits. “I am confident that the visit will impart new energy to India’s partnership with Asean and reinforce our collective commitment to a peaceful, prosperous and resilient Indo-Pacific,” Modi said in a statement published on the Indian Prime Minister’s official website. Tonight, Modi attended the Asean gala dinner hosted by President Marcos and first lady Liza Araneta Marcos at the Philippine International Convention Center.
